name: Symmetry Reducer
description: Exact search-space symmetry Feature for Campbell, Kihara and Mestre/Fermigier PGL2 searches. Supports validation-safe deduplication and optional refill-distinct coverage without modifying family plugins.

provenance.source_idea: Faugere, Huot, Joux, Renault, Vitse, Symmetrized Summation Polynomials: Using Small Order Torsion Points to Speed up Elliptic Curve Index Calculus, EUROCRYPT 2014; Rank Hunter source-height PGL2 orbit experiments
provenance.claim_boundary: Only proven coordinate/search-space equivalences are removed. No point novelty, independence, or rank claim is inferred from symmetry reduction.
provenance.runtime_scope_v2: Campbell, Kihara and Mestre/Fermigier PGL2 workers can be wrapped. v2.1.1 recognizes both legacy plugin module paths and v0.8.7 rank42.* chart-worker aliases. Dedup mode is the conservative default.
provenance.core_requirement: Rank Hunter v0.8.6.4 functional Feature hook or Rank Hunter v0.8.7.1 search-command compatibility bridge
provenance.validation_status: Campbell A/B validated. Mestre and Kihara runtime support added from exact shared chart/inverse-map semantics; run family A/B controls before treating refill-distinct mode as production-validated.
